recipe_version.title: Air-Fried Vegetable Spring Rolls
recipe_version.description: Cabbage, shiitake, and rice-vermicelli rolls air-fried until the wrappers are crisp, with a soy and lime dip. No shrimp and no fish sauce.

ingredients.name: spring roll wrappers
ingredients.note: wheat wrappers, about 8-inch squares, not rice paper

ingredients.name: rice vermicelli
ingredients.preparation: soaked until pliable, drained, cut into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: 2 for the filling, 1 for the dip

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp in the filling, 2 tbsp in the dip. Wheat and soy.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 1 tsp to soften the filling, the rest brushed on the rolls

steps.title: Soften the filling
steps.body: Soak the rice vermicelli until pliable, drain, and cut it up. Warm 1 tsp of the neutral oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add the cabbage, carrot, and shiitake and cook, stirring, until the cabbage softens, about 4 minutes. Stir in the ginger, 2 cloves of garlic, scallions, 1 tbsp soy sauce, the sesame oil, rice vinegar, and salt. Fold in the vermicelli. Spread the filling on a plate until it is cool enough to handle.

steps.title: Roll
steps.body: Lay a wrapper on a point. Place about 2 tbsp filling near the bottom, fold the point over, fold the sides in, and roll tight. Repeat for all 12. Mix the dip: remaining soy sauce, lime juice, water, sugar, the last garlic clove, and the chile. Prep is about 25 minutes.

steps.title: Air-fry
steps.body: Heat the air fryer to 375 F. Brush the rolls with the remaining neutral oil. Air-fry in two batches until the wrappers are crisp and blistered, about 8 minutes per batch, turning once. Cook is 16 minutes. Serve with the dip.
